name: IHH Healthcare Berhad
oneLine: A private hospital group with a network of 60 hospitals across Malaysia, Singapore, Türkiye, India, Greater China and other markets.
inPlainWords: IHH owns and runs private hospitals. Patients, or their insurers, pay for consultations, surgery, ward stays and tests.
It also runs diagnostic laboratories, and it owns part of a property trust (Parkway Life REIT) that holds hospital buildings and earns rent.
Malaysia is only one of its markets: most of its revenue comes from Türkiye and Europe, Singapore and India.

flow.label: Patients and insurers
flow.detail: People come for treatment and pay out of pocket or through insurance.

flow.label: 60 hospitals
flow.detail: Hospital and healthcare services brought in RM24.3 billion, about 95% of revenue (calculated).

flow.label: Laboratories
flow.detail: Diagnostic lab tests brought in about RM1.0 billion.

flow.label: Hospital property
flow.detail: Rental income of RM335 million, mostly through Parkway Life REIT.

moneyNote: Türkiye and Europe is the largest unit by revenue, but Singapore earns nearly as much operating profit from less revenue (segment EBITDA of RM1.67 billion against RM1.69 billion).
